dialog.noCpt: Open or select a CPT first.

dialog.removeHint: Remove this test from the CPT

panel.openHint: Chart, input and result of the dissipation tests

input.title: Input
input.rigidityHint: Iᵣ = G / sᵤ. For clay usually between 50 and 500; without input 100 applies.
input.coneAreaFromFile: Without input the value from the CPT file applies.
input.coneAreaDefault: Not in the CPT file; without input 1000 mm² applies.

result.title: Result
result.indicative: Indicative derivation: the theory applies to normally to lightly overconsolidated clay and the rigidity index Iᵣ is an estimate. Do not use cₕ without your own assessment.

warning.noData: Too few readings for an analysis.
warning.nonMonotonic: The pore pressure first rises (dilative behaviour). The peak is taken as the initial value and time counts from the peak (Sully et al., 1999).
warning.u0FromLast: u₀ is the last reading. That is only right if the test ran to equilibrium; otherwise enter u₀ or the groundwater level.
warning.noExcess: There is no measurable excess pore pressure; t₅₀ cannot be determined.
warning.negativeExcess: The initial value lies below u₀ (negative excess pressure). The theory for cₕ does not apply here; the result is an order of magnitude at best.
warning.t50NotReached: Half of the excess pressure did not dissipate within the test; t₅₀ cannot be determined.
warning.noT50Factor: For a filter at this position (u3) the publication gives no T*₅₀; cₕ was not calculated.
warning.groundwaterMissing: The groundwater level has not been entered.

chart.noData: Too few readings for a chart.

message.depthMissing: The depth is not in the file; enter it.
message.otherCpt: The file names CPT {{parent}}; check that it belongs to {{cpt}}.
message.notDissipation: Not a GEF dissipation file: the first column must be time.
